title: Pinecrest Spa Terrace
description: A raised spa, wide entry steps, and a stone lounge terrace were integrated into a clean-lined pool built for effortless entertaining.

title: Coconut Grove Night Pool
description: We paired a dark interior finish with layered LED lighting and a streamlined deck to create a dramatic pool after sunset.

title: Palm Beach Rain Court
description: This courtyard was transformed with an attached spa, a sculptural waterfall, and natural stone details that soften the modern geometry.

title: Boca Raton Garden Pool
description: A geometric pool and spa were carefully positioned within the garden, with crisp coping and balanced zones for swimming and relaxing.

title: Fort Lauderdale Paver Retreat
description: Large-format pavers, generous steps, and a resort-inspired layout turned this backyard into a comfortable everyday retreat.

title: Las Olas Canal Pool
description: Designed around the canal view, this pool combines a clean waterline, durable coastal finishes, and an open deck for waterfront living.

title: Coral Gables Sun Shelf
description: A spacious sun shelf, gradual entry, and light-toned finishes created a bright, family-friendly pool for lounging and play.
